item.title: Hyundai Rewards Loyal Customers With Drive For More Promo
item.description: Hyundai Motor Philippines Inc. (HMPH) launches its “Drive for More” Service Promo, a nationwide aftersales initiative geared towards rewarding Hyundai owners who maintain their vehicles through regular Periodic Maintenance Service (PMS). Running until April 30, 2026, the promo is available at all authorized Hyundai dealerships for all customers who own Hyundai vehicles sold before February 2021 and all year models of the Hyundai H100.Read More »

item.title: Review: 2026 Hyundai Kona 1.6 HEV Premium 6DCT
item.description: There are no two ways about it: Hyundai’s designs lately are eye-catching. Whether you find them quirky, endearing, or simply out of this world, they manage to strike a conversation even with non-car people. Case in point is this second-generation Kona. I’m a guy who shies away from small talk, but I was approached twice by strangers twice in a span of a week who were curious about this rather peculiar crossover.Read More »
